name: Ginzburg-Landau
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                    The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation describes a vast variety of phenomena from nonlinear 
waves to second-order phase transitions, from superconductivity, superfluidity, and 
Bose-Einstein condensation to liquid crystals and strings in field theory. 
<a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/yanglingfa/pattern/cgle/index.html">
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Ginzburg-Landau" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.1
      </param>
      <param name="alpha">
        0.082
      </param>
      <param name="beta">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="delta">
        1.31
      </param>
      <param name="gamma">
        0.0799
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.8
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.202
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_zeroPt">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="mag_controlA">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_controlB">
        1.5
      </param>
      <param name="mag_controlGamma">
        0.5
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
                                                delta_a = (c * mag_controlA + D_a) * laplacian_a + alpha*a - (gamma + c*mag_controlGamma)*b + (-beta*a + delta*b)*(a*a+b*b);
delta_b = (c * mag_controlB + D_b) * laplacian_b + alpha*b + (gamma + c*mag_controlGamma)*a + (-beta*b - delta*a)*(a*a+b*b);
c = pow(a*a + b*b, mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_zeroPt;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
